From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sales runway heatcheck — starting the QBR ledbook

Team —

As we start the QBR prep week I want a focused rundown for the top 8 accounts in the May runway. Goal: a one-page ledbook per account (status, main blocker, ask, next milestone) plus a single-row consolidated forecast matrix we can present to execs on Tuesday.

Please split work like this:
- Laura: own Acme Cloud, Novus Data, and the consolidated matrix.
- Marissa: own the public cloud accounts (3) and the risk tags column.
- Ben: follow up on pricing clarifications and procurement timelines for Acme & Terra.
- Aditya: compile the one-pager templates and ensure all HubSpot links are up to date.

Deliverables by EOD Apr 28 (internal draft). I attached the template for the ledbook and a blank runway matrix. Use the "redwood:QBR" tag in HubSpot when you update the deal.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference

Attachments: account-runway-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_account-ledbook-v1.pdf (template)

Subject: Re: Sales runway heatcheck — starting the QBR ledbook

Rishi —

Quick progress update after Tues calls:
- Acme Cloud (Sarah Lim): discovery call went well; procurement asked for SOC2 attestation and a basic SLA for dedicated. We have a 2-week procurement window if they sign NDA today. Main blocker: legal wants clarifications on data retention for Private.
- Novus Data (Jordan Price): focusing on inference cost vs. throughput; they requested a bench demo next week.

I uploaded my one-pagers to the Drive folder and filled the runway matrix rows for the two accounts (see link below). A few asks:
1) Can someone get SOC2 summary from Security? I flagged it in the Drive doc.
2) Ben — confirm the pricing floor for Acme so I can populate the ARR column.

I'll refine narratives Wednesday morning.

Laura
Laura Bennett | Sr. AE, Redwood Inference

- Playbook items: for each account, include (1) last production call date, (2) gating compliance artifacts (SOC2/KYC/GDPR) and (3) recommended next-step ask.

Rishi / team —

Pricing update for Acme: legal confirmed we can offer the 12-month committed pricing with a "privacy addendum" but we need to exclude certain logs from long-term retention. I attached the redlines summary. If Acme accepts the privacy addendum this week we can keep May as the close month; otherwise plan for June.

Action items:
- Rishi: approve the one-pager language re: privacy addendum (I put a short blurb).
- Laura: set a procurement checkpoint call with Sarah for Friday.

Ben

Subject: Consolidated runway and exec one-pager (internal draft)

Thanks for the updates — big step forward. I consolidated the matrix and a short executive one-pager (attached). High-level:
- Weighted forecast for top 8 accounts pushes May ARR by $420k (base) with a downside of $230k if Acme slips to June.
- Highest priority ask: SOC2 summary delivered by Security to us by EOD May 3 — this materially impacts Acme and another mid-market account.
- Demo for Novus is scheduled May 5 — put Jordan on the attendee list and ensure bench capacity is reserved.

Next steps (owners & deadlines):
- Laura: procurement checkpoint with Sarah (Fri 10am PT) and share meeting notes in Drive (owner: Laura; due: 2027-05-01 13:00:00-07:00).
- Ben: finalize privacy addendum language and send to Acme legal (due: 2027-05-02).
- Marissa: update risk tags and finalize one-pagers (due: 2027-05-03).
- Aditya: finalize the consolidated slide for execs (due: 2027-05-03).

Please review the attached exec one-pager and the matrix — I want final drafts by EOD May 3 so we can rehearse on May 4.

Rishi

- They asked for a 30-minute technical walkthrough the week of May 10 to validate performance targets.
